attrs.value: Welcome esteemed guests! Long time, no see! As you may observe, I have arranged for quite the welcoming committee. Hospitality is important, in spite of our differences.
Be careful. This must be another of Durand's traps. I do not think this is a real welcoming committee.
Do you have sarcasm back home, Yurik?
We must land quickly and prevent our units from being taken in the water. The priority is to secure our War Machine units and the ore deposits needed to fuel them. Move quickly!
I have plenty more gifts waiting for you if you insist on continuing to march to your own deaths.
Your era is done, Durand. We have come to finish things.

Your people will soon know who it was that started the wars that have turned Akadia into a wasteland. When they learn that your power-mongering has led to their downfall, there will be nothing left for you.
If my defeat is so inevitable, then why bother with your fighting? Let the Akadian people police this issue. Why waste more of your lives? Because I assure you, death is coming for you.
Speaking of impending doom, we met Lieutenant Hayne on our way. He was crazed, muttering something about needing to be the one that killed you. Isn't that strange for your vaunted hero?
Lies. Hayne is a loyal Akadian. He would never desert his army.

Funny, I imagine he said the same thing about you right before we showed him your secret orders commanding Akadian troops to fire on their own people, all so you could start a war to pretend to be a hero.
I think I'll kill you first, Tucker.
The first sign of a real battle and they crumble. Typical. Now, back to ruling the world...
